name: Helplexa for WooCommerce
author: pathelplexa

sections.description:
The Helplexa for WooCommerce plugin connects your WooCommerce store to your Helplexa workspace, allowing you to:

  • Embed the Helplexa chat widget on your store
  • View and respond to customer chats inside Helplexa
  • Securely sync your store and products for use in conversations
  • Share WooCommerce products with customers from your Helplexa workspace
  • Share products in conversations from connected channels such as Messenger and Instagram from your workspace
  • Reply to conversations on desktop or from the Helplexa mobile apps
  • Link workspace users and create teams to manage customer conversations
  • Manage connection settings from your WordPress admin panel and embed settings from Helplexa

A Helplexa account is required to use this plugin.
You can sign up at https://helplexa.com.

External Services

This plugin connects to Helplexa at https://helplexa.com to authenticate your account, link your WooCommerce store to your Helplexa workspace, receive widget embed settings, load the Helplexa live chat widget when embedding is enabled, and let Helplexa securely request product data for use in customer conversations.

A Helplexa account is required. Use of Helplexa is subject to the Helplexa Terms and Privacy Policy:

  • Terms: https://helplexa.com/legal/terms
  • Privacy Policy: https://helplexa.com/legal/privacy

Displaying the Chat Widget

After connecting your store:

  1. Log in to your Helplexa dashboard.
  2. Go to Widgets and either create a new chat widget or edit an existing one.
  3. Under the widget’s Domain Settings, click Change Domain.
  4. Select Integration Domain, then choose the domain linked to your WooCommerce site.
  5. Make sure the widget is enabled in its availability settings.
  6. Go to Integrations → WooCommerce in Helplexa.
  7. Toggle embedding on.

Your Helplexa chat widget will now appear on your WooCommerce store.

License

This plugin, all included libraries, and any other included assets are licensed under the MIT License, which is GPL-compatible.
sections.installation:
A Helplexa account is required to activate the plugin connection and link your store to Helplexa.

Install from WordPress admin

  1. In your WordPress admin, go to Plugins → Add New.
  2. Search for Helplexa for WooCommerce.
  3. Click Install Now.
  4. Click Activate.
  5. Go to WooCommerce → Helplexa.
  6. Click Connect to Helplexa and follow the on-screen steps.

Manual upload

  1. Download the plugin ZIP file from WordPress.org.
  2. In your WordPress admin, go to Plugins → Add New → Upload Plugin.
  3. Upload the ZIP file and click Install Now.
  4. Activate the plugin.
  5. Go to WooCommerce → Helplexa.
  6. Click Connect to Helplexa and follow the on-screen steps.

Once connected, your WooCommerce site is securely linked to your Helplexa account.
